description:
Get a product's measured design guide: fonts, colour palette, type scale, layout and
component observations, measured separately for its marketing site and product UI. Use it
for "make it look like <product>" or "trustworthy like <product>": take the tokens from here
and the structure from its screens (search_screens with product, then get_screen_image).
fonts gives each context's families by role (display, body, mono) with licence, a CSS fallback
stack and the closest free alternative plus its <link>; use the free one unless the user has
the licensed font.

context.description: Which surface to return. Omit for both.

productId.description: Product id from list_products, e.g. linear, stripe or airbnb.

name: get_design
title: Get a product's design guide
